prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving along a rocky shoreline at Castle Rock Beach, Meelup, Australia, under a clear blue sky. The camera pans smoothly from right to left, revealing large, rugged boulders scattered across the sandy beach, with sparse greenery clinging to their surfaces. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle shifts slightly downward, focusing on the sandy path that winds through dense foliage. The sunlight filters through the trees, casting dappled shadows on the ground, enhancing the vibrant greens and earthy browns of the surrounding vegetation. The path narrows as it ascends a gentle slope, with the camera continuing to move forward, capturing the intricate details of ferns and shrubs lining the trail. The natural sounds of rustling leaves and distant waves provide an immersive auditory backdrop. The camera maintains a steady pace, occasionally adjusting its angle to navigate the uneven terrain, offering a continuous and fluid exploration of this serene, sunlit coastal landscape. The absence of people adds to the sense of solitude and tranquility, allowing the viewer to fully immerse in the natural beauty of Castle Rock Beach.
